title: lists max 7 or split
name: Lists max 7 or split — Canada.ca
rule: Lists ≤7 items, or split by category. One idea per bullet; consistent grammar; numbered only for rank/order/steps. Lead-in must apply to every item (“all of” vs “one or more”).
pass_when: A list is ≤7 or split by category; numbered only for rank/order/steps; lead-in applies to every item.
fail_when: 8+ undifferentiated items; numbered list with no order; lead-in that does not apply to every item.
overview: Lists stay at seven items or split by category with a fitting lead-in.
apply_when: Writing Canada.ca bullet or numbered lists in task content.
not_when: Data tables — use table rules, not list length caps.
agent_hint: Cap lists at seven or split by category; number only for order; lead-in fits all.
description: Canada.ca lists stay at seven items or split by category. One idea per bullet, consistent grammar, and numbers only for rank, order, or steps. The lead-in must apply to every item (“all of” versus “one or more”). Fail eight or more undifferentiated items, a numbered list with no order, or a lead-in that does not cover every item.
